consent.title: Terms of Use
consent.heading: Venue Use Agreement
consent.description: Review the venue rules, equipment responsibilities, and personal-data notice before entering the reservation system.
consent.agreementTitle: NCU Office of Student Affairs Venue Use Agreement
consent.agreeLabel: I have read and agree to follow the venue use rules above
consent.readComplete: You have finished reading the terms and may now agree.
consent.readRequired: Read the complete agreement before confirming.

responsibility.title: Purpose and Responsibility
responsibility.description: Applicants must use the venue only for the approved purpose and keep the activity consistent with the submitted request.
responsibility.item1: Use is limited to the approved date, time, and area. The venue may not be transferred or used for another purpose.
responsibility.item2: Keep the venue clean and restore it after the activity, including waste removal and checks of doors, windows, and power.
responsibility.item3: Applicants must cooperate with follow-up action when inaccurate information or improper use causes damage.

equipment.title: Equipment Use and Damage
equipment.description: Borrowed equipment must be operated according to on-site rules and returned to its designated location after the activity.
equipment.item1: Count microphones, projection equipment, furniture, extension cords, and other items before and after use.
equipment.item2: Report malfunctions, shortages, or damage to the managing unit immediately. Do not disassemble or repair equipment yourself.
equipment.item3: Applicants may be responsible for repairs when improper operation causes equipment damage.

safety.title: Activity Safety and Order
safety.description: Activities must protect participants, campus order, and the rights of nearby users.
safety.item1: Do not block evacuation routes, fire-safety equipment, entrances, exits, or public walkways.
safety.item2: Control the volume of audio systems and large equipment to avoid disrupting nearby teaching or office work.
safety.item3: The managing unit may adjust or cancel use because of natural disasters, power outages, or other events beyond its control.

review.title: Cancellation, Withdrawal, and Review
review.description: Every request remains subject to review and is not confirmed until approved by the managing unit.
review.item1: If the date, time, purpose, or equipment changes after submission, update the request in the system or submit a new one.
review.item2: Pending requests may be withdrawn in the system. Contact the managing unit to cancel an approved request.
review.item3: The managing unit may approve or adjust requests based on maintenance, activity type, or university needs.

privacy.title: Personal Data Notice
privacy.description: Application data is used for review, communications, and reservation-record management.
privacy.item1: Names, phone numbers, email addresses, and activity details are used only for this system's demonstration, review, and management processes.
privacy.item2: This sample is not final legal text. The responsible office must review and publish the official version.
privacy.item3: Applicants can view their own reservation records and review status in the system.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.description: The applicant acknowledges that this agreement contains sample content. Official notices, review messages, and on-site staff instructions govern actual venue use.
